question: Who among the following Vijaynagar rulers married his daughter to Firuz Shah Bahmani?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deva Raya I.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Firuz Shah Bahmani **was a ruler of the** Bahmani Sultanate,** a Muslim kingdom in South India during the **14th to 16th centuries.i.**
 
• It was Deva Raya I who had married his** daughter** to Firuz Shah Bahmani, as mentioned in the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Vijayanagara Empire** was a Hindu kingdom that ruled South India from the** 14th to the 17th centuries**, with its capital at Vijayanagara (now Hampi in Karnataka).
 
• **Deva Raya II **was a **Vijayanagara ruler** who ruled from **1424 to 1446 CE**.
 
 
• He succeeded **Saluva Narasimha Deva Raya, **who was the founder of the Saluva dynasty that ruled the Vijayanagara Empire for a brief period.
 
 
 
• **Krishna Deva Raya** was a Vijayanagara ruler who ruled from **1509 to 1530 CE.**
 
 
• **​** He is considered one of the greatest rulers of the Vijayanagara Empire, and his reign is known as the **Golden Age of the empire.**
 
• He patronized several famous poets, scholars, and artists, and his military campaigns expanded the empire's territory to its** greatest extent.**
 
 
 
• **Bukka I **was the brother and successor of **Harihara I**, the co-founder of the Vijayanagara Empire.
